label: Maximum TRUE_3 implies maximum being, conditionally from a truth/being reading
meaning: Conditional formal inference from the globally quantified truth/being biconditional in STMT-AS-TO-BEING-SO-TO-TRUTH to Aquinas's maximal-truth/maximal-being conditional. Metaphysics II.1 is contextual evidence for, but does not itself state, the biconditional or the Thomistic TRUE_3 conformity sense; claim b7d959b1 has been narrowed accordingly.
